backend/main.mo: Main canister actor implementing authorization, user profiles, media storage, allowlist management, and version/deployment tracking.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old persisted actor state to the new format, primarily normalizing publishedMedia.images.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two frontend feature updates with affected files, components, test IDs, and confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of various frontend files for documentation or build reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based CSS defining color variables, dark mode values, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx with a basic document structure.
frontend/public/PLACEHOLDER_MEDIA_README: Developer instructions explaining uploaded-only media behavior, empty states, and how to use the in-app Media Manager.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling password gate, intro popup, all main sections, media manager, popups, and ambient effects.
frontend/src/components/FlipImageCard.ts: 3D flip-card component showing an image on the front and a message on the back with keyboard and pointer interaction.
frontend/src/components/FloatingHearts.t: Ambient animation component rendering floating heart emojis with randomized timing and positions.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Renders the hero section with optional background image, media manager button, and decorative birthday text.
frontend/src/components/ImageAdjustModal: Provides a modal for zooming and panning an image, allowing users to adjust and save image transforms.
frontend/src/components/ImageMemorySecti: Displays a grid of memory images with flip cards and fallback states using stored URLs and transforms.
frontend/src/components/IntroPopup.tsx: Shows an animated introductory popup with a simple close button.
frontend/src/components/LockScreen.tsx: Implements a password lock screen with error feedback and unlock handling.
Shows a modal love letter with typing animation and close control.
frontend/src/components/MediaManager.tsx: Full media management interface for uploading, adjusting, ordering, and publishing hero images, gallery images, videos, and song.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: Audio player component with autoplay handling, tap-to-play prompt, and play/pause control tied to a stored song URL.
frontend/src/components/ProposalPopup.ts: Popup modal showing a romantic proposal message with animated visuals and close controls.
frontend/src/components/RosePetals.tsx: Renders falling rose petal emoji elements with randomized animation positions and timing.
Section with two buttons that trigger opening a love letter and a proposal popup.
frontend/src/components/VideoMemorySecti: Displays up to six uploaded videos with mute toggle and empty slot states.
frontend/src/config/imageMemory.ts: Generates 43 image memory items, each paired with a message pulled from romanticMessages.
frontend/src/config/romanticMessages.ts: Array of predefined romantic messages used for image memory cards.
frontend/src/config/videoMemory.ts: Defines six video memory slots as simple ID objects.
frontend/src/context/MediaStoreContext.t: Context managing loading, storing, uploading, and publishing of hero, image, video, and song media with backend sync.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity auth, managing AuthClient creation, stored identity loading, and login state.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaDraft.ts: Manages local media draft state including files, ordering, transforms, and drag-and-drop interactions.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaManagerPermis: Fetches and computes admin and uploader permissions for media actions using backend actor queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaStore.ts: Re-exports the media store context hook for accessing shared media state.
frontend/src/hooks/usePublishWithPrechec: Handles pre-publish validation and publishing media to the backend, with error normalization and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionGate.ts: Implements a simple session unlock gate using a fixed password stored in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useTypingText.ts: Creates a typing animation effect by progressively revealing text over time.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles and romantic-themed animations, colors, and UI effects.
frontend/src/lib/deployDiagnostics.ts: Provides utilities to normalize, stringify, and format diagnostic errors for publishing and deployment flows.
frontend/src/lib/localMediaStore.ts: IndexedDB wrapper storing hero, image, video, and song blobs with functions to save, load, list, and clear media slots.
frontend/src/lib/mediaDiagnostics.ts: Provides structured console logging for app-start and submit diagnostics, logging only counts, booleans, and indices.
frontend/src/lib/publishedMediaClient.ts: Handles uploading and clearing hero, image, video, and song media to the backend with slot validation and progress reporting.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and renders the root component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, typography, container queries, animations, and component styling.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing architecture, features, known issues, and configuration for a React + IC canister media app.
